method: Independent disjoint matched-hidden-world holdouts. Same ordinary tile on two legal branches, more vs fewer focal remaining playable tiles; each comparison fixes tile/pips, source hand, world, and bot policy. Opponent-access split is based on paired after-action playable-tile difference; descriptive, not causal.
prospectiveAccessThreshold: nextPlayableDelta > 0 vs <= 0 (set before examining new seeds; no subgroup tuning)
worldSeedFormula: mixSeed32(dealSeed xor imul(turn+1,0x9e3779b9) xor imul(seat+1,0x85ebca6b) xor imul(worldIndex+1,0xc2b2ae35))
runtime: V8 CommonJS harness with actual GitHub simulator source; Node CLI not run
limitations: Branch-opening interpretation remains provisional; geometry fixture checks internal consistency, not human-game confirmation.
Access is measured after candidate action, so access strata cannot establish causal moderation.
Uniform hidden worlds conditional on no-stock passes ignore prior policy-choice likelihood.
First eligible reachable position per trajectory, simple deterministic bots, correlated worlds, exploratory position-cluster normal intervals without multiplicity correction.
No block winner; finish-first is not match win. Historical 4,000 rounds excluded.
exactNextAction: Validate locked/open branch semantics against a human-confirmed multi-branch move fixture; repeat same-tile comparison with pre-action opponent hand/open-end characteristics and prospective holdout, or build a branch-specific opponent access score that does not condition on post-action outcomes.
